description:
Turn physical paperwork into high-impact digital action. IntelliDoc is your all-in-one AI document assistant-built to scan crisp PDFs, automatically redact sensitive personal data, sign contracts, and transform messy handwritten notes into polished executive deliverables in seconds.

Whether you are managing contracts, filing business expenses, or turning quick meeting notes into formal minutes, IntelliDoc gives you an intelligent workflow that keeps your private data secure.

SMART SCANNING & PERMANENT REDACTION

• Auto-Detect & Enhance: Capture contracts, receipts, IDs, and multi-page forms with automatic border detection, perspective correction, and shadow removal.
• On-Device PII Redaction: Instantly identify and permanently black out Social Security Numbers (SSNs), credit card details, emails, and phone numbers before exporting.
• True Data Sanitization: Redacted text and sensitive metadata are permanently removed from the underlying PDF binary—not just covered with visual boxes.

AI HANDWRITING & WORKFLOW TRANSFORMATION

• Handwriting to DOCX & PDF: Convert rough handwritten notes and sketches into clean, editable text documents.
• Executive Meeting Minutes: Automatically structure brainstorming scribbles into formal minutes with agenda items, key decisions, and action tables with assignees.
• AI Rewrite Studio: Turn meeting notes into professional follow-up emails, slide deck outlines, or LinkedIn thought leadership posts with one tap.

MULTI-PROFILE E-SIGNATURES & AUDIT TRAIL

• Saved Signature Kits: Store your full signature, initials, company stamps, and date badges for quick drag-and-drop placement.
• Certified Audit Trail: Generate a verifiable Certificate of Completion featuring cryptographic SHA-256 document hashing and timestamps.
• Flattened PDF Export: Signatures are burned directly into the document layer to prevent tampering or unauthorized extraction.

SMART FILING & BIOMETRIC VAULTS

• AI Auto-Naming & Routing: Intelligent OCR suggestions automatically generate clean, standardized file names and recommend the right folder.
• Face ID & Touch ID Protection: Lock confidential folders (Tax, Medical, Legal) behind biometric security that seals automatically when the app closes.
• Universal Full-Text Search: Search inside any scanned document instantly by keyword, vendor name, or transaction date.
• Smart Compression: Choose from tailored export presets for email attachments (>5MB), government portals (>1MB), or high-res archival print.

PRIVACY FIRST

Your data belongs to you. IntelliDoc performs optical character recognition (OCR) and redaction locally on your device. Your biometrics stay safely inside Apple's Secure Enclave, and your documents are never sold or used for public AI training.

SUBSCRIPTION and LEGAL

IntelliDoc offers flexible subscription options (Annual and Monthly) as well as Lifetime access. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store Account Settings.

• Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
